snippet.title: Golden Sun The Lost Age: 20th Anniversary mod
snippet.description:
Note: I have moved away from modding a long time ago. But I have decided to keep this and similar videos up for people still interested.  I might have to remove all traces of this past eventually if I become a big enough game developer.  But for now, I think I can keep this up.  Just don't expect any more updates or for me to respond to questions or concerns.

You can download a patch to play for yourself below...
https://jackitk.itch.io/gstla-20thanniversary

Like what you see?  projects I do along with social media accounts you can follow me on for updates.
https://jackitku2b.wixsite.com/jackitK
